act.name: Citizenship Act, 1955
act.source_authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing acquisition, registration, naturalisation, overseas citizenship and termination of Indian citizenship.

sections.title: Citizenship by registration.
sections.text: Section 5 concerns categories and conditions for acquiring Indian citizenship by registration; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Eligible applicants in the statutory categories may seek Indian citizenship by registration subject to prescribed conditions and procedure.
